title: Squeeze Play: Initiative to Reduce Token Costs with Adaptive Batching, Cache TTLs, and Micro-Quant Profiles
creator: Lena Chen
description: Executive summary: Squeeze Play is a targeted initiative to reduce per-token serving cost for medium-latency workloads by combining three levers: dynamic request batching tuned per-route, adaptive KV/prefix cache TTLs driven by workload signals, and experimentally scoped 'micro-quant' profiles (lighter quantization with minimal quality regression). Scope: hosted API routes with >1k reqs/day and 50-300 token reply medians; Dedicated early adopters will be invited to opt in for controlled rollouts. We will not change model weights or retrain; all work is on inference serving and orchestration. Goals: 1) Reduce average token cost by 18-25% for targeted routes; 2) Maintain P95 latency SLO within +10% of baseline and keep quality regressions under 1.5% on eval sets; 3) Provide an automated rollout path (canary -> 50% -> full) with rollback triggers tied to latency or quality signals. Approach: - Phase A: Instrumentation & signal baseline (2 weeks) — detailed per-route latency, tokenization patterns, cache hit/eviction patterns, and per-request batching compatibility. - Phase B: Field trials (6 weeks) — run adaptive batching policies, TTL heuristics, and two micro-quant profiles in parallel with A/B measurement. - Phase C: Rollout + console UX (4 weeks) — expose recommended profiles in Console, add cost savings simulation, and publish a rollout cookbook. Constraints & guardrails: automatic throttling if P95 latency increases >10% or customer error rates increase; privacy: no payload inspect beyond token counts and hashes; compatibility: avoid routes that use streaming + function-calling in initial trials. Success criteria and acceptance conditions are enumerated below.

acceptance_criteria: Automated per-route simulation shows >=18% median token cost reduction for at least 3 candidate routes without exceeding quality regression threshold of 1.5% on eval sets.
Canary rollout path implemented in Console with 1-click rollback; runbook tested by SRE and exercised in staging.
Dashboard surfaces per-route savings, P95 latency delta, error rate, and quality regression signals; alerting thresholds configured.
Field trial runbook includes customer opt-in flow and communication templates for Dedicated/Private customers.
